editorial:
Imagine being a legendary cop who has spent his whole life doing the right thing, only to have your past come back to bite you. That is exactly what happens to Cheung Sung-bong. He is a total pro at his job, but things get messy when his former student returns with a huge grudge. The vibe here is like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where the lines between the good guys and bad guys start to blur. You get a mix of intense police work and personal drama that keeps you guessing about who is actually in control of the situation.

What really makes this work is the acting and the crazy action scenes. The fights are punchy and the tension builds up perfectly. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit familiar if you watch a lot of crime movies, the energy never drops. If you love gritty police stories, you should definitely check this out. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a massive showdown between the mentor and the student. You find out that the revenge plot was deeper than it first seemed, involving old betrayals and lost family. After a brutal final fight, the bad guys are taken down, but it comes at a heavy emotional cost. The two main characters finally face the truth about their shared past, leaving you with a bittersweet feeling as the credits roll.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-energy police thrillers and emotional revenge stories.
